name: com.minux-trading/buyer-tools
title: Minux buyer tools
description: Container load plans, HS codes and a stone and porcelain catalogue, with links buyers open.

tools.name: plan_container_load
tools.description: Plan how porcelain/ceramic tiles (on pallets) or stone/porcelain slabs (on A-frames) load into a 20ft, 40ft or 40ft high-cube container, with the engine behind the public planner at minux-trading.com. Returns m², pallets or slabs, cargo weight, what limits the load (weight or space), the 60/40 balance, an optional order split across containers, and links that open the exact plan, its engineering loading drawing, and a prefilled quote form for the buyer. Start from a preset (see list_load_presets) and override any field. A planning estimate for typical export packing, not a loading instruction and not a price.

preset.description: A packing preset id (e.g. 60x120-9, marble-320x160-20) or format page slug (e.g. porcelain-tiles-60x60-9mm). Implies tiles or slabs.

mode.description: tiles (boxes on pallets) or slabs (upright on A-frames). Needed only without a preset.

container.description: 20gp (20ft), 40gp (40ft), 40hc (40ft high cube), trailer (13.6 m road semi-trailer) or boxcar (rail covered wagon 11-280, 1,520 mm gauge). Default 20gp. An order is split across the three containers, or across trucks or wagons of the one kind asked for.

payload_limit_kg.description: Cargo weight limit in kg (1000–70000, capped at the vehicle's rating). Default 26000 for containers, 24000 for the trailer (set the route's legal road limit) and 68000 for the boxcar; road limits at origin or destination are often lower.

tile_length_cm.description: tile length, cm (tiles only; tiles 5–400). Overrides the preset.

tile_width_cm.description: tile width, cm (tiles only; tiles 5–200). Overrides the preset.

thickness_mm.description: thickness, mm (tiles and slabs; tiles 3–40, slabs 3–60). Overrides the preset.

pieces_per_box.description: pieces per box (tiles only; tiles 1–60). Overrides the preset.

boxes_per_pallet.description: boxes per pallet (tiles only; tiles 1–200). Overrides the preset.

pallet_length_cm.description: pallet length, cm (tiles only; tiles 40–400). Overrides the preset.

pallet_width_cm.description: pallet width, cm (tiles only; tiles 40–240). Overrides the preset.

pallet_height_cm.description: pallet height with load, cm (tiles only; tiles 10–260). Overrides the preset.

pallet_tare_kg.description: pallet tare, kg (tiles only; tiles 0–300). Overrides the preset.

m2_per_box.description: m² per box (tiles only; tiles 0.05–20). Overrides the preset. From the buyer's packing list; leave out to estimate.

kg_per_box.description: kg per box (tiles only; tiles 1–400). Overrides the preset. From the buyer's packing list; leave out to estimate.

slab_length_cm.description: slab length, cm (slabs only; slabs 50–400). Overrides the preset.

slab_width_cm.description: slab width, cm (slabs only; slabs 30–260). Overrides the preset.

density_kg_per_m3.description: stone density, kg/m³ (slabs only; slabs 1500–3200). Overrides the preset.

spacer_mm.description: spacer between slabs, mm (slabs only; slabs 0–30). Overrides the preset.

rack_allowance_mm.description: A-frame allowance per row, mm (slabs only; slabs 0–1200). Overrides the preset.

packaging_kg_per_slab.description: packaging per slab, kg (slabs only; slabs 0–60). Overrides the preset.

frame_kg_per_row.description: frame weight per row, kg (slabs only; slabs 0–800). Overrides the preset.

slabs_per_bundle.description: slabs per bundle (slabs only; slabs 1–200). Overrides the preset.

kg_per_slab.description: kg per slab (slabs only; slabs 5–2000). Overrides the preset. From the buyer's packing list; leave out to estimate.

allow_stacking.description: Tiles only: allow stacking pallets two high when the height allows. Default true.

order_quantity.description: The order size (1–1000000), with order_unit. Returns how many containers of each size it needs.

order_unit.description: m2, boxes or pallets for tiles; m2 or slabs for slabs.

locale.description: Language of the returned links and texts: en (English), ru (Russian) or ar (Arabic). Default en.

tools.name: list_load_presets
tools.description: The packing presets the container planner knows: common porcelain tile, paver and slab formats and marble, travertine, granite and quartzite slabs, with their export packing and the format page that answers 'how much fits in a container' for each. Use an id as plan_container_load's preset.

locale.description: Language of the returned links and texts: en (English), ru (Russian) or ar (Arabic). Default en.

tools.name: find_hs_code
tools.description: The HS 2022 six-digit customs code for natural stone, porcelain/ceramic tiles, engineered stone or ceramic sanitary ware, from the same decision table as the public HS code finder. It states only what the answers decide: when a test value is missing (tile water absorption) it returns the heading and every candidate subheading with the value that selects it. A classification aid, not a binding ruling; national tariffs add digits.

material_family.description: stone (natural stone), ceramic (tiles, mosaic, trims), engineered (agglomerated/quartz stone) or sanitary (ceramic sanitary ware).

form.description: For stone: block, sawn (merely cut into rectangles), cut-to-size, worked (polished/honed/shaped) or mosaic. For ceramic: tile, mosaic (cubes under 7 cm) or finishing (trims, skirting).

water_absorption.description: For ceramic tiles: tested water absorption — le-0.5 (≤ 0.5%, porcelain), 0.5-10, gt-10 (> 10%), or unknown.

body.description: For sanitary ware: porcelain or other ceramic body.

locale.description: Language of the returned links and texts: en (English), ru (Russian) or ar (Arabic). Default en.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the live Minux catalogue (porcelain tiles and slabs, natural stone) by name, category and format. Returns names, specifications and product page links in the buyer's language. No prices.

query.description: Words from the product name, e.g. 'travertine', 'calacatta', 'grey'.

locale.description: Language of the returned links and texts: en (English), ru (Russian) or ar (Arabic). Default en.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One catalogue product by its slug (from search_products): description, sizes, thickness, finish, origin, HS code as listed, minimum order as listed, the product page and a prefilled quote form for the buyer. No prices.

slug.description: The product slug, e.g. as returned by search_products.

locale.description: Language of the returned links and texts: en (English), ru (Russian) or ar (Arabic). Default en.

tools.name: build_quote_link
tools.description: A link to the Minux quote form, prefilled with a product and/or a container plan (a planner query such as preset=60x60-9&c=40hc&q=3000&qu=m2). Opening it sends nothing: the buyer reviews the form, adds contact details and sends it. Use it whenever the buyer asks for a price, availability or a lead time.

plan_query.description: A container planner query (the part after ? in a plan link).

locale.description: Language of the returned links and texts: en (English), ru (Russian) or ar (Arabic). Default en.
